Players Committee errata-sheet slip of [[General Leia Organa (Errata)]] (PC-E1), game text: “While at a war room or battleground, game text of Admiral's Orders is canceled and whenever you initiate a battle with a Resistance character, retrieve 1 Force (2 if initiating against a First Order character). Immune to attrition < 4.”

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Errata-082022.pdf Errata Sheet August 2022] (Players Committee), page 1, PDF built 6 August 2022. The slip is the image embedded in the PDF; its transparent areas (where the card underneath shows through) are shown white.

Edits: none.
